name: LeaveParty
description: Make NPC(s) leave the player's party.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for followers.
prompt: If the player tells you to stop following them, go home or leave their party, or you decide to leave the party yourself, begin your response with '{key}:'
